proposition: Melvin-Koushki's thematic list classes Sullam Dār al-Salām among apologies and creedal works as well as works on Sufism, so a design that applies the duress rule to creedal tracts must decide whether to treat this work as free or coerced; that call is not made in the dissertation on these pages.
